capability_investigated:
WhisperProcessor feature extraction (input_features padding/truncation to a
single 30s / 3000-frame mel window) and generate()'s acceptance of batched
features + a list of prompts returning a list of per-window results.
what_i_learned:
The processor caps every call at one 30-second mel window, so the stub
silently deleted all audio past 0:30 on long-form calls. generate() is not
single-window: stacking N feature windows (axis 0) with an N-length prompt
list yields N ordered results, each with its own sequences_ids — the batch
decode path the pipeline had never used.
hypothesis:
Deletion is the dominant axis because the tail is dropped. Windowing the raw
audio into consecutive 30s chunks, batching them through one generate call,
and concatenating the decoded segments should recover the deleted tail and
sharply lower corpus_cer.
